candidate.summary: Upgrade after review. 15 upstream API breaking changes, no usage of the changed parts located in this repository — review before upgrading.

runtimeAnalyses.statement: Upstream requires Python >=3.10; this repository declares Python 3.14 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 3.11 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 3.13 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 7.3.20 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 3.14 in .github/workflows/codspeed-walltime.yml, 3.14 in .github/workflows/codspeed.yml, 3.14 in .github/workflows/publish.yml, 3.15 in .github/workflows/tests-vcs-deps.yml, 3.14 in .github/workflows/upgrade-ci-pins.yml, which satisfies it.

breaking.remediation: The parameters of `pydantic.dataclasses.dataclass` changed; its return type did not. Update every call site to pass arguments matching the new list — check argument order, argument count, and whether an options object replaced positional arguments. A call that only reads the result of `pydantic.dataclasses.dataclass` needs no change beyond its arguments.

evidence.title: 2 API surface change(s) in pydantic

breaking.remediation: Every use of `pydantic.experimental.missing_sentinel.MISSING` from `pydantic` must be replaced. Find the supported replacement in the new version's exports and migrate each call site. Do not stub `pydantic.experimental.missing_sentinel.MISSING` out or re-implement it locally unless no replacement exists — if none exists, say so in the PR description rather than inventing one.
